purpose: Create a deterministic private one-click pre-recruitment audit bundle that retains every denominator, exposes invalid-outcome partial-identification risk, and fails closed until scientific, ethical, governance, clustering, mechanism, accessibility, and sample-size decisions have external evidence.

fixed_decisions: instrument content identity and version separation
six directional dangerous-error domains separately in English and Japanese
integer-count and unrounded binary64 Wilson decisions
attempted, invalid, valid, and eligible denominators retained separately
public UI withheld until a separately governed release decision
blocking_decisions_requiring_external_re: target-population estimand under invalid or withdrawn outcomes
minimum valid eligible n per cell
cluster unit, allocation, and cluster-aware analysis
accessibility, device, and proficiency strata and minima
stopping, deviation, and blinded exclusion rules
ethics review, consent, recruitment, data governance, retention, and incident response
decision_register_contract.readiness_rule: RecruitmentReady may be true only when every blocking row is resolved with a nonblank evidence reference, protocol content identity is frozen, ethics and recruitment scope match that identity, and all automated schema checks pass.
decision_register_contract.anti_self_approval: Repository-generated files cannot constitute ethics approval, recruitment authorization, scientific owner approval, privacy review, or consent authorization.

denominator_ledger_contract.unit: One non-identifying StudyRecordId per scheduled ConfirmatorySlotId; every scheduled slot remains represented regardless of consent, eligibility, start, withdrawal, completion, validity, or analysis disposition.
denominator_ledger_contract.identifier_policy: Only study-scoped pseudonymous codes are allowed. Direct names, email, phone, address, date of birth, IP address, contact fields, and unrestricted free text are rejected.
denominator_ledger_contract.outcome_lock_policy: Exclusion decisions must be preregistered automatic or documented blinded review. Post-outcome exclusion is forbidden.
denominator_ledger_contract.reason_policy: Every excluded, partial, withdrawn, invalid, or protocol-deviating record must use a registered categorical reason code; blank and free-text substitution fail closed.
denominator_ledger_contract.coverage_policy: When a frozen assignment manifest is supplied, missing, duplicate, or unexpected ConfirmatorySlotId values fail closed.
denominator_ledger_contract.pii_review: PIIReviewed and AuditReviewed are attestations, not automated de-identification or independent audit.

invalidity_reason_contract.no_silent_drop: Invalid or withdrawn outcomes remain in denominator and reason-code audits even if absent from the valid-eligible Wilson denominator.
invalidity_reason_contract.amendment_rule: An unregistered reason cannot be recoded to other after inspecting outcomes; it requires a dated protocol amendment and separate reporting.

partial_identification_sensitivity.lower_bound: DangerousErrors/(ValidEligibleN+InvalidEligibleN), treating every invalid eligible outcome as safe.
partial_identification_sensitivity.upper_bound: (DangerousErrors+InvalidEligibleN)/(ValidEligibleN+InvalidEligibleN), treating every invalid eligible outcome as dangerous.
partial_identification_sensitivity.wilson_reporting: Retain the observed-valid one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound and the all-invalid-dangerous one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound. Both use raw binary64 values and strict <0.10 decisions.
partial_identification_sensitivity.robustness: RobustToInvalidOutcomes is true only when the all-invalid-dangerous Wilson upper bound is strictly below 0.10. This is a worst-case sensitivity label, not a missing-data identification claim.
partial_identification_sensitivity.sample_size_policy: All rows are retained and none selects n, an acceptable invalidity ratio, or an observed error target.

private_bundle_contract.archive: Deterministic ZIP with lexicographic member order, fixed timestamps and permissions, no human rows, and SHA-256 manifest validation.
private_bundle_contract.first_read: START_HERE and the readiness summary must lead with Blocked, list unresolved blocking decisions, and state that the bundle is not ethics approval or recruitment authority.
private_bundle_contract.surface: Private downloadable artifact only; no Streamlit selector, evidence button, or public route is enabled by this work.

cases: default decision register is blocked rather than falsely ready
repository-generated ethics evidence cannot self-authorize recruitment
direct identifier or unrestricted free-text columns fail ledger validation
missing, duplicate, and unexpected frozen slot ids fail coverage validation
unregistered invalidity reason and post-outcome exclusion fail closed
partial-identification bounds reproduce integer formulas and widen monotonically with invalid count
worst-case robustness implies observed-valid Wilson pass but not conversely
display rounding never changes the robustness flag
deterministic bundle bytes reproduce and member/hash tampering fails validation

automated_success_gates.identity: Every parent hash matches before execution.
automated_success_gates.register: Fixed and unresolved decisions match the plan; every unresolved blocking row has blank evidence and RecruitmentReady=false.
automated_success_gates.ledger: The zero-row exact-schema template, data dictionary, banned-column audit, categorical codebook, and frozen-slot coverage validator pass synthetic fixtures.
automated_success_gates.partial_identification: Every registered n x observed-rate x invalid-ratio row reproduces integer counts, proportions, Wilson bounds, strict decisions, and monotonic worst-case risk without selecting a row.
automated_success_gates.bundle: The private ZIP has exactly the registered members, deterministic bytes, correct internal hashes, zero human rows, and a blocked first read.
automated_success_gates.human_gate: HumanParticipants=0, EthicsApprovalAvailable=false, RecruitmentAuthorized=false, MinimumValidPerCellRegistered=false, PlannedRecruitmentNSelected=false, ConfirmatoryResultAvailable=false, and PublicSurfaceEnabled=false.
automated_success_gates.tests: New protocol-preflight tests plus selected dependence, planning, gate, operations, comprehension, one-click, archive, and decision-stability tests pass.

interpretation_limits.readiness: Passing this software contract means the package fails closed correctly; it does not mean the human study is ready.
interpretation_limits.bounds: Worst-case invalid-outcome bounds may be conservative and do not identify MNAR; narrower assumptions require external justification and prospective registration.
interpretation_limits.privacy: Banned-column checks and attestations cannot prove de-identification or regulatory compliance.
interpretation_limits.ethics: Only an appropriate independent review body and authorized institutional roles can approve the study, consent, recruitment, and data governance.
interpretation_limits.statistics: A future protocol still must select estimands, n, multiplicity, cluster-aware analysis, mechanism protection, and accessibility/language objectives before responses.
